images.title: How to compare *two quotes*
steps: Duties, monthly volume for each one, and every system the work touches.
Setup, software, usage at your real volume and expected changes.
Note which duties each quote covers and which still need a person.
Hours of coverage a week, and the hours your staff will spend on it.
Whether you keep the rules, the log and the phone number if you leave.
Compare with the full cost of a person for the same duties.
